final_square_regeneration_prompts.prompt: Create ONE original fantasy guardian creature as a polished 2D Japanese anime production cel for a fantasy RPG. This is an anime illustration with confident elegant dark ink contour lines, deliberate line-weight variation, clean graphic shapes and crisp two-tone cel shading. Beautiful restrained color palette, mature animal anatomy, small expressive anime eyes, carefully designed silhouette. Charming and cool, NOT chibi, not a plush toy, no gigantic head or eyes, no 3D render, no painterly realism, no glossy plastic, no airbrush glow, no particle confetti or AI-looking overdecoration. Full body three-quarter pose facing LEFT, the entire silhouette visible with 10 percent safe margin. Genuine transparent background and clean alpha edges, no ground, scene, cast shadow, writing, watermark or UI. One creature only. Rimefang Wolf: a slender silver-gray snow wolf with ice-blue eyes, dark slate back markings, three small crystalline blue spikes at its shoulder and a sweeping natural wolf tail. Four paws with believable canine anatomy. Calm watchful expression, one forepaw raised. Strong economical anime linework, broad flat fur color masses rather than thousands of hairs. Accent colors icy blue and muted silver. CRITICAL OUTPUT: SQUARE 1:1 canvas, isolated character sticker with genuine fully transparent exterior. All creature pixels opaque; no aura, no fog, no painted background, no vignette, no glow. Plain flat anime cel illustration, absolutely NO environmental lighting. Center the drawing with generous fully transparent margins.

Make the entire exterior fully transparent (alpha 0); make the creature itself opaque (alpha 255) with clean antialiased contour edges. Preserve the exact anime creature drawing, pose, colors, anatomy and cel shading unchanged. This is an isolated reusable transparent PNG character cutout, NOT artwork on a dark background. No new shadows or halos.
